# ai.moms™

> ai.moms™ teaches moms to use AI the mom way, so they can get their time back at home, at work and in their business. We teach Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, from the ground up, with on-demand courses, private sessions, in-person experiences and a membership community.

Founder: Raquel Cadourcy, Approved Claude SMB Trainer. Aime is the personal assistant each mom builds in Claude, her AI Chief Everything Officer™. It recommends, she decides.

## Learn

- [The Foundations Course](https://aimoms.ai/foundations): Learn Claude from the ground up, with demos for the mom at home, the mom at work and the mompreneur. 6 modules, 44 short lessons, 25 ready-made skills.
- [Build Aime](https://aimoms.ai/build-aime): Build Aime, plus 25 ready-made skills for Claude, for the daily brief, the weekly plan and dinner.
- [The Top 3 Session](https://aimoms.ai/top3): One private 90-minute session on Zoom or in NYC. Bring your 3 biggest headaches or wishes and leave with them done.
- [Membership](https://aimoms.ai/membership): A monthly live AI session on Zoom, guest speakers, a private WhatsApp community and access to in-person events.

## Bring ai.moms™ to your group

- [Host an Experience](https://aimoms.ai/experiences): A hands-on, 3-hour experience at your home, where every mom leaves with Aime set up.
- [Your Town](https://aimoms.ai/your-town): Host a workshop or become a Founding Mom Ambassador.
- [ERG & Corporate](https://aimoms.ai/corporate): Hands-on AI workshops for working parents, on-site or virtual.

## Resources

- [Skill Guide](https://aimoms.ai/skill-guide): All 25 skills in the ai.moms™ plugin for Claude, what each one does and when to use it.
- [Editorial](https://aimoms.ai/editorial): Articles for moms learning AI.
